verses.en: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam the son of Nebat reigned Abijam over Judah.
verses.sm: Isaraelu O le sefulu ma le valu o tausaga o le tupu o lerepoamo le atalii o Nepata, na fai ai Aviama ma tupu o Iuta.

verses.en: Three years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.
verses.sm: E tolu tausaga na fai ai o ia ma tupu i Ierusalema. O le igoa o lona tina o Maaka le afafine o Apisaloma.

verses.en: And he walked in all the sins of his father, which he had done before him: and his heart was not perfect with the LORD his God, as the heart of David his father.
verses.sm: Na savali o ia i agasala uma a lona tama na ia faia e muamua ia te ia; ua le atoatoa lona loto i le ALII lona Atua, e pei o le loto o lona tama o Tavita.

verses.en: Nevertheless for David's sake did the LORD his God give him a lamp in Jerusalem, to set up his son after him, and to establish Jerusalem:
verses.sm: A e peitai ona o Tavita ua foaiina e le ALII lona Atua ia te ia o le lamepa i Ierusalema, i le faatuina o lona atalii ina ua mavae atu o ia, ma le faatumauina o Ierusalema.

verses.en: Because David did that which was right in the eyes of the LORD, and turned not aside from any thing that he commanded him all the days of his life, save only in the matter of Uriah the Hittite.
verses.sm: Aua na faia e Tavita o mea e tusa.i luma o le ALI, na ia le liliu ese i se mea e tasi na ia fetalai mai ai ia te la, i aso uma lava o lona ola, ua na o le mea na ia faia la Uria le sa Heti.

verses.en: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all the days of his life.
verses.sm: Ua utu tau Reopoamo ma Ierepoamo i tausaga uma o lona ola.

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Abijam, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.
verses.sm: O toe o mea na faia e Aviama, ma mea uma na ia faia, e lei tusia ea i le tusi o tala i nofoaiga a tupu o Iuta? Na utu tau foi Aviama ma Ierepoamo.

verses.en: And Abijam slept with his fathers; and they buried him in the city of David: and Asa his son reigned in his stead.
verses.sm: Ua taoto Aviama faatasi ma ona tama, ua latou tanu foi ia te ia i le aai a Tavita; ona soloai ane lea o Asa lona atalii e fai ma tupu.

verses.en: And in the twentieth year of Jeroboam king of Israel reigned Asa over Judah.
verses.sm: O le lua sefulu o tausaga o Ierepoamo le tupu o Isaraelu na fai ai Asa ma tupu o luta.

verses.en: And forty and one years reigned he in Jerusalem. And his mother's name was Maachah, the daughter of Abishalom.
verses.sm: E fagafulu ma le tasi o tausaga na fai ai o ia ma tupu i Ierusalema. O le igoa foi o lona tina o Maaka le afafine o Apisaloma.

verses.en: And Asa did that which was right in the eyes of the LORD, as did David his father.
verses.sm: Ua amiotonu foi Asa i luma o le ALII, e pei o Tavita lona tama.

verses.en: And he took away the sodomites out of the land, and removed all the idols that his fathers had made.
verses.sm: Ua ave ese e ia tagata faasotoma i le nuu, ma na aveesea tupua uma na faia e ona tama.

verses.en: And also Maachah his mother, even her he removed from being queen, because she had made an idol in a grove; and Asa destroyed her idol, and burnt it by the brook Kidron.
verses.sm: O Maaka foi lona tina, ua ia aveesea o ia ia le fai o ia ma saʻo tamaitai, aua na ia faia le tupua o Asaira; ua ta i lalo e Asa o lana tupua, ma susunuina i le alia o Ketarono.

verses.en: But the high places were not removed: nevertheless Asa's heart was perfect with the LORD all his days.
verses.sm: A e lei aveesea o mea maualuluga; a o le loto o Asa na atoatoa lea i le ALII i ona aso uma.

verses.en: And he brought in the things which his father had dedicated, and the things which himself had dedicated, into the house of the LORD, silver, and gold, and vessels.
verses.sm: Ua au mai foi e 1a ile fale o le ALII o mea na faasaina e lona tama, ma mea foi na faasaina e ia, o ario, ma auro, ma ipu.

verses.en: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
verses.sm: Na utu tau Asa ma Paasa le tupu o Isaraelu i o la aso uma.

verses.en: And Baasha king of Israel went up against Judah, and built Ramah, that he might not suffer any to go out or come in to Asa king of Judah.
verses.sm: Ona alu ae ai lea o Paasa le tupu o Isaraelu i luta, ua ia faia foi Rama, ina ia le mafai ai se tasi ona sau pe alu atu ia Asa le tupu o luta.

verses.en: Then Asa took all the silver and the gold that were left in the treasures of the house of the LORD, and the treasures of the king's house, and delivered them into the hand of his servants: and king Asa sent them to Ben-hadad, the son of Tabrimon, the son of Hezion, king of Syria, that dwelt at Damascus, saying,
verses.sm: Ona ave lea e Asa O le ario ma le auro uma ua totoe i olof o le fale o le ALII, ma oloa o le fale o le tupu, ua»avatu ai i lima o ana auauna; ua avatua foi e le tupu o Asa ia Peniata le atalii o Taperimoni le atalii o Hesiona, le tupu o Suria, o le sa nofo i Tamaseko, ua faapea atu,

verses.en: There is a league between me and thee, and between my father and thy father: behold, I have sent unto thee a present of silver and gold; come and break thy league with Baasha king of Israel, that he may depart from me.
verses.sm: O loo ia te i taua le feagaiga ma oe, o loʻu tama foi ma lou tama; faauta, ua Ou avatu ia te oe mea alofa, o ario ma auro; ina e maliu mai ia, ma tatala la oulua feagaiga ma Paasa le tupu o Isaraelu, ina ia alu ese ia ia te au.

verses.en: So Ben-hadad hearkened unto king Asa, and sent the captains of the hosts which he had against the cities of Israel, and smote Ijon, and Dan, and Abel-beth-maachah, and all Cinneroth, with all the land of Naphtali.
verses.sm: Ona faalogo lea o Peniata i le tupu o Asa, ma ia aauina atu i aai o Isaraelu o e avea ‘au sa ia te ia, ma na fafasi i Iono, ma Tanu, ma Apela Petemaaka, ma Kinereta uma, i le ma le nuu uma o Nafatali.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Baasha heard thereof, that he left off building of Ramah, and dwelt in Tirzah.
verses.sm: Ua faalogo ai Paasa, ona tuua lea e ia ona fai 0 Rama; ua nofo foi o ia i Tiresa.

verses.en: Then king Asa made a proclamation throughout all Judah; none was exempted: and they took away the stones of Ramah, and the timber thereof, wherewith Baasha had builded; and king Asa built with them Geba of Benjamin, and Mizpah.
verses.sm: Ona tala‘i atu ai lea e le tupu o Asa ia Iuta uma, ua le tuu sa‘oloto se toatasi; ona latou ave ese lea o maa o Rama ma ona laau na fai ai le galuega e Paasa, a ua fai aʻi e le tupu o Asa o Kipea i Peniamina, ma Mesepa.

verses.en: The rest of all the acts of Asa, and all his might, and all that he did, and the cities which he built, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah? Nevertheless in the time of his old age he was diseased in his feet.
verses.sm: O toe o mea uma na faia e Asa, ma lona fitafita uma ma mea uma na ia faia, ma aai na ia faia, ua le tu ia ea ia ile tusi o tala i nofoaiga a tupu o Iuta? A ua oo ina toeaina, ona mai ai lea o ia i ona vae.

verses.en: And Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David his father: and Jehoshaphat his son reigned in his stead.
verses.sm: Ua taoto Asa faatasi ma ona tama, ua tanumia foi o ia faatasi ma ona tamā i le aai a Tavita lona tama; ona soloai ane lea o Iosefatu lona atalii e fai ma tupu.

verses.en: And Nadab the son of Jeroboam began to reign over Israel in the second year of Asa king of Judah, and reigned over Israel two years.
verses.sm: O le lua o tausaga o Asa le tupu o Iuta, na fai ai Natapu le atalii o Ierepoamo ma tupu o Isaraelu, e lua tausaga na fai ai o ia ma tupu ia Isaraelu.

verses.en: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of his father, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.
verses.sm: Ua amio leaga foi o ia i luma o le ALII, ua ia savali foi i le ala o lona tamà ma lana agasala na ia faatupuina ai le. agasala 1a Isaraelu.

verses.en: And Baasha the son of Ahijah, of the house of Issachar, conspired against him; and Baasha smote him at Gibbethon, which belonged to the Philistines; for Nadab and all Israel laid siege to Gibbethon.
verses.sm: Ua foua o ia e Paasa le atalii o Akia o le aiga o Isakara; ua fasia foi o ia e Paasa i Kipetonu o le aai a Filisitia; aua na vagaia Kipetonu e Natapu ma Isaraelu uma.

verses.en: Even in the third year of Asa king of Judah did Baasha slay him, and reigned in his stead.
verses.sm: Ua fasiotia o ia e Paasa i le tolu o tausaga o Asa le tupu o Iuta; ua fai foi o ia ma tupu e sui aio ia.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when he reigned, that he smote all the house of Jeroboam; he left not to Jeroboam any that breathed, until he had destroyed him, according unto the saying of the LORD, which he spake by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite:
verses.sm: Ua fai o ia ma tupu, ona ia fasiotia lea o le aiga uma o Ierepoamo; ua ia le faatoeina se tasi tagata ola ia Ierepoamo, a ua faaumatia lava, e tusa ma le afioga a le ALII na ia fetaiai mai ai na aumaia e lana auauna o Akia o le Sailo,

verses.en: Because of the sins of Jeroboam which he sinned, and which he made Israel sin, by his provocation wherewith he provoked the LORD God of Israel to anger.
verses.sm: ona o agasala a lerepoamo na ia faia, ma agasala foi a Isaraelu na ia faatupuina i lona faaonoono na ia faaonoono ai i le ALII le Atua o Isaraelu.

verses.en: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all that he did, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel?
verses.sm: O toe o mea na faia e Natapu, ma mea uma na ia faia, e lei tusia ea ia i le tusi o tala i nofoaiga a tupu o Isaraelu?

verses.en: And there was war between Asa and Baasha king of Israel all their days.
verses.sm: Na utu tau Asa ma Paasa le tupu o Isaraelu i o la aso uma.

verses.en: In the third year of Asa king of Judah began Baasha the son of Ahijah to reign over all Israel in Tirzah, twenty and four years.
verses.sm: O le tolu o tausaga o Asa le tupu o Iuta ua fai ai Paasa le atalii o Akia ma tupu o Isaraelu uma i Tiresa; e lua sefulu ma le fa tausaga o lana nofoaiga.

verses.en: And he did evil in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the way of Jeroboam, and in his sin wherewith he made Israel to sin.
verses.sm: Ua amio leaga ia i luma o le ALII, ua ia savali foi i le ala o Ierepoamo, ma lana agasala na ia faatupuina ai le agasala ia Isaraelu.
